name: Seated Chest Press Machine

instructions.description: Adjust the seat and sit with the back supported.
Place the hands on the handles and keep wrists neutral.
Return the handles slowly until a comfortable stretch is felt.

performanceMetrics.notes: Record the external load used without treating it as a universal target.

variations.variationDescription: Seated Chest Press Machine — Tempo-Controlled Version: Use a deliberately slower lowering phase without creating a separate database record.
Seated Chest Press Machine — Reduced-Range Version: Use a smaller comfortable range while preserving the same movement pattern.

commentsNotes: Adjust the seat so handles align comfortably with the chest.
